name: zweapon_on_weapons_section_data_ready
description: zWeapon::OnWeaponsSectionDataReady restores the weapon damage-feedback hit count from WeaponData and resets the lock-on warning gate.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this callback; tier S verification is deferred to the zWeapon/OptCatalog source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b1160 validates the fastcall data-ready ABI, reading the stack buffer argument as the WeaponData hit-count blob, storing 0.0f to g_OptCatalogLockOnWarningGateTimeSec, restoring g_OptCatalog_DamageFeedbackHitCount, and callee-cleaning the three stack arguments.
The native smoke verifies lock-on warning gate reset and hit-count restoration from the supplied WeaponData payload.
